title: Re-importing a fully different old number creates a separate part
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), with 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete' and See Financial Data.
  • Part {Number-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-IMPRENAMED-02) is stocked at {Location-A} with Sell Price $20.00. It was created as {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-IMPOLD-01) and then renamed to this fully different number.
  • The description you will put in the file is {Description-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL Import Old CSV).
custom_steps:
1. Go to Settings → Data Import → Inventory.
  2. Download the template the screen offers.
  3. In the file, fill one row: Part Number {Part-A}, Description {Description-B}, Sell Price 33.00, and the other columns the template requires (for example Category Uncategorized and Cost 10.00).
  4. Upload the file.
  5. Run the import.
  6. Go to Parts → Inventory and type {Part-A} in the search.
  7. Type {Number-A} in the search.
  8. Go to Parts → Part Library and type {Part-A} in the search.
  9. Type {Number-A} in the Part Library search.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 5: the import finishes.
  • Step 6: a new part {Part-A} is listed, with Sell Price $33.00.
  • Step 7: the renamed part {Number-A} is untouched, with Sell Price $20.00.
  • Steps 8 and 9: two entries, {Part-A} and {Number-A} (1 + 1 = 2).

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10826 (Story 13, The Part Dialog); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, as edited 9 Oct 2026 (Ready for dev), S13-E1, read 13 Oct 2026; design canvas: no board shows this behaviour (13 Oct copy). Tech plan §6 Phase 6 functional tests (ImportTest). Source-verified 13 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S13-E1: “Pointing a part at a different Part Library entry is not offered in the part dialog, and the system refuses it by any other route. Re-importing a part through the parts CSV import with a fully different old number creates a separate part under the old number. Both are for the merge and duplicate tool (Out of scope).”
  • Tech plan, 7 Oct 2026, §6 Phase 6 functional tests (ImportTest): “after a rename, re-importing a row under the old number creates a separate part under the old number; the renamed part is untouched”
